description: Use to find a wallet's recent activity or a real transaction signature to inspect. Never invent a signature; get one here. Lists a wallet's most recent transaction signatures, newest first, with status and a plain-language error name for failures. Inputs: wallet: The wallet whose transactions to read. limit (optional): How many signatures to return. Default 10. network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/get_recent_transactions.
name: get_recent_transactions
